tasks.text: What colour is the shading (fill) of the note paragraph "신규 고객 34곳 중 21곳이 수도권."? Answer `ANSWER: fill=<colour>`.

What is the left indent of the quotation "“고객이 있는 곳에 지점이 있어야 한다.”…"? Answer `ANSWER: indent-left=<pt>`.
What is the font size of the text "15% 성장"? Answer `ANSWER: size=<pt>`.
